name: Build a Tower with Friends
desc:
You can start building the tower from scratch! Create a Free private server in the "Servers" tab at the bottom this page
👇👇👇

🏗️Build the tallest tower!

⛏️Mine
🔨Cut
🧱Place
⬆️Upgrade

🔃To reset your tower, write "/iwantresetmytower" in the chat or in the console (enable it in the settings)
⚠️This can be done once every 2 weeks

And thank you for your likes, we are very pleased❤️

The idea for the game is taken from the [Social Game] world called "Monument" by Sylan Troh
I want to say that I do not appropriate this idea to myself,
I was greatly inspired by this idea and decided to try to create it in Roblox,
in the future the place will be very different
